_readme: One place for the facts the whole site repeats. build.py reads this file, expands the {{TOKENS}}, and hands it to the page as window.__SITE__. It also feeds the search-engine fallback, the structured data, llms.txt and pricing.md, so nothing here can drift apart. Edit here, run `python3 build.py`, commit docs/.

shipping._note: Must match Shopify > Markets > India > Shipping. When `free` is true the site says so on the ribbon, product pages and cart. If you add a paid rate below a threshold, set freeFrom to that amount (0 = free on everything) and fee to the charge below it.

bundles._note: Bundle prices. Each one is a Shopify discount code (Admin > Discounts) that applies once per order; the site applies the single best one at checkout via ?discount=CODE. Set live:false until the code exists in Shopify.

forms._note: Paste a form endpoint that accepts a JSON POST (Formspree, Web3Forms, a Google Apps Script web app). While this is empty the newsletter box is replaced by an Instagram follow button and the contact form opens WhatsApp or email, so nothing a visitor types is ever silently dropped.

tracking._note: The pixel is off while metaPixelId is empty. Filling it in loads the Meta Pixel on pastforward.shop (PageView, ViewContent, AddToCart, InitiateCheckout); use the same pixel id Shopify's Facebook & Instagram channel uses, so the whole journey is one funnel. Before switching it on, change the 'Your cart and cookies' line in the privacy policy below, which currently says the site uses no trackers. Campaign tags (utm_*, fbclid) are passed to the Shopify checkout whether or not the pixel is on.
tracking._shopifyNote: Sends page views, product views and add-to-carts to Shopify analytics (Headless channel storefront 'Past Forward Headless'), so Shopify Admin sessions, reports and Live View count visits to this site. Empty shopifyShopId turns it off.

faq: Is it a real vinyl record?
Yes. A real 12-inch upcycled record. Every record we sell already had a life before it got to you; we clean it up and set the artwork into the centre label. Nothing is pressed new for decor.
Can I play it?

It's sold to hang, not to play. These are real records, so the grooves are real — but we make no promise about what's on them or how it sounds, and the label carries our artwork rather than the original. Treat it as a wall piece.
Why upcycled and not new?
Because a record that already had a life is the whole point of the name. It also means no two are identical, and nothing new gets pressed just to hang on a wall.

{{SIZES}}
How does a record hang?
Every record comes with a wall hook in the box. Put the hook up and hang the record on it.
How long does delivery take?

What does delivery cost?
{{SHIPPING_LINE}}
How can I pay?
By {{PAYMENTS}}, on a secure checkout. {{COD_LINE}}
Do you ship outside India?
Not yet. We deliver anywhere in India for now.
What if it arrives damaged?
{{DAMAGE_LINE}} See returns.
Can you make one that isn't on the site?
Yes. That's what custom orders are for — tell us the artist and album and we'll make it.
How do I look after it?
Wipe with a dry cloth. Keep it out of direct sunlight — same as the original.

sections: The size most people mean by a wall poster. Big enough to read from across a room, small enough for a hostel or rented room. Ours are {{PRICE_A3}}.
A quarter of an A3, about the size of a paperback page. Good on a desk, a shelf, a bedside wall or in a cluster of small pieces. Ours are {{PRICE_A5}}.
A square print that keeps an album cover's original shape, so nothing is cropped. Works well in a grid of four or nine. Ours are {{PRICE_10}}.
Where A4 fits in
A4 (21 × 29.7 cm) sits between the two: an A3 is two A4s, and an A4 is two A5s. We don't make A4.
How to choose

Measure the space and imagine it filled to about two-thirds. For a gap under 40 cm wide, go A5 or a single 10×10. For 40 to 90 cm, one A3 or a pair of 10×10s. Above that, mix sizes: one A3 with smaller pieces round it.
faq: Is A3 bigger than A4?
Yes. A3 is exactly twice the area of A4: 29.7 × 42 cm against 21 × 29.7 cm.
What size is a 12-inch vinyl record?

/how-to-hang-vinyl-records-on-a-wall.title: How to Hang Vinyl Records on a Wall (Layouts, Height, Hooks) | PastForward
/how-to-hang-vinyl-records-on-a-wall.desc: How to hang vinyl records on a wall: what to hang them with, how high, how far apart, three layouts that work, and how to keep them from warping.
/how-to-hang-vinyl-records-on-a-wall.h1: How to hang vinyl records on a wall.
/how-to-hang-vinyl-records-on-a-wall.sub: Hooks, height, spacing and layouts, from the people who make records to hang.
sections: What to hang it with

A 12-inch record weighs roughly 120 to 180 grams, so it needs very little. A small nail or a screw with a wall plug, or a removable adhesive hook rated well above that weight, will hold one. Every PastForward record comes with a wall hook in the box.
How high

Put the centre of the record, or the centre of a group of records, at roughly eye level: about 145 to 150 cm from the floor. Above a bed or sofa, leave about 20 to 25 cm between the furniture and the bottom of the lowest record.
How far apart
Records are about 30.5 cm across. Leave 5 to 8 cm between them so each one reads as its own piece. Use the same gap everywhere and the wall looks planned.
Three layouts that work

A straight row of three above a bed or desk. A grid of four or nine for a feature wall, measured out with paper circles taped up first. Or a loose diagonal climbing a staircase wall, keeping the gap between records the same.
Keeping them flat
Vinyl softens with heat. Keep records off walls that get direct afternoon sun or sit right next to a heater or kitchen stove, and the label print stays brighter too.
faq: Can I hang a record without drilling?
Yes. A removable adhesive hook rated for a few hundred grams holds a single record on a smooth painted wall.
Will a hung record still play?
Ours are made to hang, not to play. The album art is set into the centre label.

/poster-wall-ideas-for-bedroom.desc: Six poster wall layouts for a bedroom, with sizes and spacing: the single statement, the row, the grid, the gallery mix, the polaroid wall, and records with posters.
/poster-wall-ideas-for-bedroom.h1: Poster wall ideas for your bedroom.
/poster-wall-ideas-for-bedroom.sub: Six layouts, with the sizes and spacing that make each one work.
sections: 1. One statement piece
A single A3 (29.7 × 42 cm) centred above the bed, its bottom edge 20 to 25 cm above the headboard. The simplest wall that still looks finished.
2. The row
Three A3s or three 10×10 prints in a line, 5 cm apart. Pick three albums from one artist or one era so the row reads as a set.
3. The grid
Four or nine 10×10 prints in a square, gaps kept identical. Album covers are square to begin with, so a grid of them looks deliberate.
4. The gallery mix
One A3 as the anchor, with A5s and 10×10s around it. Lay everything out on the floor first, then copy it to the wall with paper templates and removable putty.
5. The polaroid wall
Fifteen to twenty polaroid cards in a tight grid, or clipped to a string across the wall. The cheapest way to cover a lot of wall.
6. Records with posters
An upcycled record next to the A3 poster of the same album. The round shape breaks up a wall of rectangles.
faq: How do I put posters up without damaging the wall?
Removable mounting putty or poster strips. Ordinary tape can lift paint when it comes off.
What size poster goes above a bed?
An A3 for a single bed, or two or three A3s in a row for a double. See the poster size guide.

faq: How do custom vinyl records and custom posters work?

For custom posters, we reproduce your requested album art or personal photo on 300 GSM matte art paper in A3, A5, 10×10, or polaroid sizes.
Are custom vinyl records playable on a turntable?

No. Like every record we make, our custom vinyls are designed to hang as wall decor, not to play on a turntable. The authentic vintage vinyl grooves are 100% real, but they are made and sold as music wall decor.

Custom vinyl records use authentic 12-inch reclaimed phonograph discs (⌀305mm) with printed centre labels and pre-installed hanging hooks. Custom posters use heavy 300 GSM archival matte artboard that prevents curling and reflections.
